punchline: Kiyosaki's rich dad banned one sentence at home: I can't afford it.
thirty_sec: Kiyosaki had two fathers. One had a Ph.D. and ran Hawaii's schools. The other, his best friend's dad, had left school early. The first said get good grades and find a safe job. The second banned the phrase "I can't afford it" and asked how he could afford it instead. The Ph.D. dad resigned to run for office, lost, and was out of work. The other became one of the richest men in Hawaii.
